headline: A mechanical keyboard deal for $35
standfirst: Custom keyboards usually cost hundreds, but this model is heavily discounted.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: The 65-percent Glorious GMMK 3 keyboard is on sale at Woot for $34.99.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Use the code WOOTGAMING at checkout to drop the price from its usual $139.99.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: It is a low-risk way to try custom mechanical keyboards without spending a fortune.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Check your final price at checkout to ensure the discount code applies correctly.

caption:
